messages:
Sam: Heads up — my PR #4124 is red in CI, pre-commit formatting + typecheck gates failing. I didn't touch Rust but rustfmt diffs show up and pyright/mypy also error. Anyone else seeing this?
ci-bot: check status: pre-commit.formatting (rustfmt) — FAILED
  files: crates/runtime/src/cache.rs
pyright — 1 error
mypy — 2 errors
Run '/retest' to queue a retry.
Mia: saw a cluster of formatting failures during the 03:00 deploy window earlier, could be a tooling bump. link: https://ci.internal/runs/12345
Rahul: can someone bisect infra/tooling? last few commits included a pre-commit/tooling bump. might be the pin.
Sam: I'm starting a local bisect, will report back if I find the exact commit.
Mia: quick note — the infra/tooling repo had a pre-commit update + some linters pinned yesterday. @Katie pushed that change. @Katie?
Katie: yep, that was me. Bumped pre-commit and a couple of tool pins (rustfmt, black, isort) to get the CVE patch. I didn't expect rustfmt output to change semantics but versions can vary.
Sam: copying failing snippets from CI to help triage:
```
crates/runtime/src/cache.rs: formatting mismatch (rustfmt diff)
--- a/crates/runtime/src/cache.rs
+++ b/crates/runtime/src/cache.rs
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
-use crate::utils::cache::Cache;
+use crate::utils::cache::Cache;
```
```
pyright output:
src/frontend/handlers.py:25:5 - error: Name 'Config' is not defined
  25 |     def get(self, cfg: Config):
```
```
mypy output:
src/utils/typing.py:12: error: Argument 1 to 'foo' has incompatible type 'Optional[str]'; expected 'str'
```

Mia: that mypy error smells like a stricter optional check, maybe mypy config changed too.
ci-bot: /retest queued on runner-9 (job 98765)
Mia: repro steps: pulled main, ran pre-commit locally in a container with tooling pins from infra/tooling@main — got same rustfmt diffs. Bisect points to commit 5f3a9b in infra/tooling that changed rustfmt pin.
Katie: confirmed — the commit bumped rustfmt 1.4.20 -> 1.5.0. Rolling back to 1.4.20 eliminates the diff.
Rahul: ok I'll open a PR in infra/tooling to revert the rustfmt pin and add a note to do a coordinated repo-wide formatting run before bumping next time.
Rahul: PR created: https://git.internal/infra/tooling/pulls/78 (revert rustfmt pin). cc @Katie for verification.
Mia: after temporary revert applied in infra/tooling and rerunning CI on the affected PR, formatting and typecheck gates passed on runner-9.
Katie: I'll follow up with infra team to add a gating job that runs rustfmt across a sample set of repos when bumping rustfmt. also adding a changelog entry. :thumbsup:
Sam: thanks all — action items: (1) Rahul revert PR merged, (2) Katie follow up with infra for gating job, (3) Mia smoke test on a couple more repos. leaving thread open for any regressions. :raised_hands:
